# Display World

> Display World is a digital signage company in Dubai, UAE. We supply, install and maintain LED video walls, LCD video walls, interactive kiosks, transparent displays and architectural signage for offices, retail, hotels, healthcare, education and airports across the UAE and Qatar.

## Contact
- Address: Office no 203, Falcon House, Dubai Investment Park, Jebel Ali, Dubai, UAE
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 50 841 1925
- Sales: salessupport@displayworldme.com
- Support: support@displayworldme.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 08:30 to 18:00, Saturday 09:00 to 14:00 (Gulf Standard Time)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/displayworld.ae/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61561607341527

## What we do
- Indoor LED video walls, including fine pitch from P0.9 to P2.5
- Outdoor LED screens and billboards with weatherproof cabinets for Gulf heat
- LCD video walls with thin bezels for control rooms, lobbies and flight information displays
- Interactive touchscreen kiosks and wayfinding stands
- Transparent LED and OLED for shop windows and glass facades
- Architectural signage: illuminated 3D letters, entrance pylons and wayfinding signs
- Content management software to schedule what plays on every screen
- Site surveys, mounting design, installation, colour calibration and annual maintenance contracts (AMC)

## Maintenance plans (AMC)
- Bronze: remote diagnostics with an 8-hour response and two preventive visits a year
- Silver: on-site engineer within 4 hours, quarterly maintenance and parts cover
- Gold: 24/7 emergency dispatch within 2 hours, monthly visits and spare parts kept on hand
